run_racecar_simulation: run the pybullet racecar differential simulation with interactive velocity and steering sliders
create_gear_constraints: create gear constraints between racecar wheel joints to simulate a differential drive system
set_joint_motor_control: set joint motor control on racecar wheels using velocity control and position control modes
add_debug_sliders: add user debug parameters for wheel velocity, max force, and steering angle control
load_racecar_urdf: load the racecar differential URDF model and inspect its joint information
